content:
**Costa Business** is a series of quests in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Once in a Blue Moon* update.

Resident grouch and taskmaster, Vinny Costa, hasn't been happy with the performance of his employees lately, and he'd be happy to throw some caps at anyone willing to solve the problem. The series of 7 quests can only be completed once. Each of the quests had a unique Blue Ridge themed reward, which ranges from CAMP items to outfits.

- Interact with Vinny and select "I'm looking for some work" in the dialogue box.
- Vinny will ask you to go and speak to one of his staff, find out why they are feeling miserable, and then return back to him.
- This is a series of "daily" side quests. Each day you will need to go and visit Vinny and he will tell you which staff member to speak to next.
- There are 8 staff members in total to find and speak to. You can only visit one staff member every 20 hours.

All quest rewards include Base Caps: 80, Base XP: 200, Contextual Ammo, Brew Goodies or Aid Goodies x1, and the unique items noted below.

- Costa Business: Kieran: Kieran will send you to Nuka World on Tour to collect 5 Nuka-Cola trucks. Unique reward - Plan: Blue Ridge Toy Truck
- Costa Business: Eugenie: Eugenie will send you to Summerville to locate a letter for her. Unique reward - Plan: Blue Ridge Themed Stash Box
- Costa Business: Rudy: Rudy will give you a shopping list and ask you to collect the items on the list. Unique reward - Rudy's Canned Pozole (+1 Luck & +2 Charisma for 10 minutes) and Plan: Clean Blue Ridge Sleeping Bag
- Costa Business: Libby: Libby will send you to Pleasant Hills Cemetery to locate some parts for her gun. Unique reward - Plan: Blue Ridge Guardsman Paint
- Costa Business: Herschel: Herschel will send you to Torrance House to retrieve 5 notes written by Jacque. Unique reward - Plan: Blue Ridge Scout Helmet
- Costa Business: Vera: You will need to have finished The Bucket List quest and have a camera with film in your inventory. Take pictures of the Mountainside Bed & Breakfast sign, Cow Spot Creamery sign, and the Ferris Wheel Tyler County Fairground. Unique reward - Plan: Vera's Outfit
- Costa Business: Carver: Carver will send you to Lewisberg to find a note from his late father. Unique reward - Plan: Trucker Uniform
- Protocol Adonais: You will have needed to have completed the Laying Lowe questline, the Out of the Blue questline from Steel Reign, AND completed the other 7 Blue Ridge NPC's questlines for this side quest to pop up. Aries will ask you to collect holotapes from all over the map. Unique reward - Plan: Sheepsquatch Poster
